calls.reason: Anthropic's April 20 disclosure ties reliability problems to growth straining infrastructure, and the March 2 outage was attributed to unprecedented demand; status records show further recurring outages.
Outages are documented, but nothing links them to financial inability, and the $30B February raise cuts against it; the claim is largely rhetorical.
Anthropic's S-1 shows subscriptions at only 17% of 2025 revenue and 20% in H1 2026, with consumption the substantial majority, so the claim fails for at least one named company.
NVIDIA's note on securing inventory ahead of demand and a later AWS storage report don't establish years of sold GPUs being warehoused industry-wide.
GitHub moved to usage billing, but Anthropic doubled limits in May and October reporting says subscriptions remain heavily subsidized; the evidence is mixed and the horizon is vague.
The conditional premise, Anthropic being forced to provide stable service, has not occurred; capacity and limit announcements don't test it.
